scope: Exploratory scientific classification only. No production gate or tolerance changes. Window changes must persist and full residuals must be small for a steady claim; stable fluctuation statistics are needed for a stationary-unsteady claim.
discretization_context: Cutoff-v1 reference errors and coarse/fine differences in the existing report motivate a stringent drift screen, not a proof of continuum accuracy. Residuals are reported dimensionally and with fixed H=2 normalization. Reference error remains separate from time-window drift.
window_sensitivity: Compare primary adjacent .5 windows and combined 1.0 windows once available. Secondary .1/.2 windows diagnose current drift without authorizing an early persistent-settling claim.
